setting.en: You have just chosen a new family doctor at the health centre. At the first visit she wants to know your medical history: past illnesses and operations, allergies, the medicines you take, your family's health and how you live.
setting.de: Du hast gerade eine neue Hausärztin im Gesundheitszentrum gewählt. Beim ersten Besuch möchte sie deine Krankengeschichte kennen: frühere Krankheiten und Operationen, Allergien, die Medikamente, die du nimmst, die Gesundheit deiner Familie und wie du lebst.
setting.it: Hai appena scelto un nuovo medico di famiglia al centro sanitario. Alla prima visita la dottoressa vuole conoscere la tua storia clinica: malattie e operazioni passate, allergie, i farmaci che prendi, la salute della tua famiglia e il tuo stile di vita.

role: Zdravnica Andreja, the family doctor {learner} has just chosen, at the first visit. Thorough, kind, unhurried: takes the history (illnesses, operations, allergies, medicines, family, habits), asks follow-ups and says why, ends with a blood test. Nothing alarming. Says vi.
